## Overview {#sec-overview}

::: {.callout-note}
## Dataset
10X Genomics Visium HD Human Colon Cancer dataset at **16µm bin resolution**.
Raw data downloaded from [10X Genomics](https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/visium-hd-cytassist-gene-expression-libraries-of-human-colon-cancer).
:::

This report documents the quality control and preprocessing steps applied to the
Visium HD dataset prior to downstream spatial GSEA analysis.

## Data Loading {#sec-load}

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| cache: true

data_dir <- here("data/raw/Visium_HD_Human_Colon_Cancer_binned_outputs/binned_outputs/square_016um")

visium_obj <- Load10X_Spatial(
  data.dir = data_dir,
  filename = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  assay    = "Spatial",
  image    = Read10X_Image(
    image.dir  = file.path(data_dir, "spatial"),
    image.name = "tissue_lowres_image.png"
  )
)

cat("Initial dimensions:", ncol(visium_obj), "spots ×", nrow(visium_obj), "genes\n")
```

## Quality Control {#sec-qc}

### Computing QC Metrics

```{r}
#| label: compute-qc

visium_obj[["percent.mt"]]   <- PercentageFeatureSet(visium_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
visium_obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(visium_obj, pattern = "^RP[SL]")
visium_obj[["log10_complexity"]] <- log10(visium_obj$nFeature_Spatial) /
                                     log10(visium_obj$nCount_Spatial)
```

### Metric Distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-qc-violin
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of QC metrics across all spots before filtering."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

VlnPlot(
  visium_obj,
  features = c("nCount_Spatial", "nFeature_Spatial", "percent.mt"),
  pt.size  = 0,
  ncol     = 3
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-qc-scatter

df_qc <- data.frame(
  nCount   = visium_obj$nCount_Spatial,
  nFeature = visium_obj$nFeature_Spatial,
  pct_mt   = visium_obj$percent.mt
)

ggplot(df_qc, aes(x = nCount, y = nFeature, colour = pct_mt)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "% MT") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "UMI vs Genes per spot",
       subtitle = "Coloured by mitochondrial percentage",
       x = "nCount (log10)", y = "nFeature (log10)") +
  theme_spatial()
```

### Spatial Distribution of QC Metrics

```{r}
#| label: fig-spatial-qc

SpatialFeaturePlot(
```

## Filtering {#sec-filter}

```{r}
#| label: filter-spots

# Threshold selection — based on quantile inspection
message("nCount quantiles:")
print(quantile(visium_obj$nCount_Spatial,   probs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.95, 0.99)))
message("nFeature quantiles:")
print(quantile(visium_obj$nFeature_Spatial, probs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.95, 0.99)))
message("percent.mt quantiles:")
print(quantile(visium_obj$percent.mt,       probs = c(0.90, 0.95, 0.99)))

spots_before <- ncol(visium_obj)

# ADJUST THRESHOLDS based on your quantile output
visium_obj <- subset(
  visium_obj,
  subset = nCount_Spatial   >  100   &
           nCount_Spatial   < 50000  &
           nFeature_Spatial >  50    &
           percent.mt       <  25
)

spots_after <- ncol(visium_obj)

cat(sprintf(
  "Spots: %d → %d (%.1f%% retained)\n",
  spots_before, spots_after, spots_after / spots_before * 100
))
```

## Normalisation {#sec-normalise}

```{r}
#| label: sctransform
#| cache: true

library(future)
plan("multicore", workers = 4)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)

visium_obj <- SCTransform(
  visium_obj,
  assay           = "Spatial",
  vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",
  verbose         = FALSE,
  return.only.var.genes = FALSE
)
```

## Dimensionality Reduction & Clustering {#sec-dimred}

```{r}
#| label: dimred
#| cache: true

visium_obj <- RunPCA(visium_obj, assay = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)
visium_obj <- FindNeighbors(visium_obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
visium_obj <- FindClusters(visium_obj, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
visium_obj <- RunUMAP(visium_obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-umap-clusters
#| fig-cap: "UMAP embedding coloured by Seurat cluster (interactive)."

p_umap <- DimPlot(visium_obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.4) +
  theme_spatial() +
  ggtitle("UMAP — Seurat clusters")

ggplotly(p_umap)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-spatial-clusters
#| fig-cap: "Spatial map of cluster assignments across the tissue section."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

SpatialDimPlot(visium_obj, label = TRUE, label.size = 3)
```

## Summary {#sec-summary}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Step              = c("Raw spots", "After QC filtering", "Genes retained",
                        "Normalisation", "Clusters identified"),
  Value             = c(
    spots_before,
    spots_after,
    nrow(visium_obj),
    "SCTransform (percent.mt regressed)",
    nlevels(Idents(visium_obj))
  )
)

datatable(summary_df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"),
          caption = "Preprocessing summary")
```
